Pomegranate-Green Tea Cocktail
By: Chris Paulk
Published: Thursday, May 5, 2011 - 4:24pm

Ingredients




3 ounces green tea
1 oz. ginger syrup
1 ounce pomegranate juice
A few seasonal berries,
a lime wedge and mint leaves
Optional: Add 2 oz of vodka

Preparation

1 Muddle the fruit and mint leaves, 2 Add the liquid ingredients 3 To a shaker. Roll (don't shake) liquid ingredients between 4 The shaker and a pint glass full of ice.   Serve garnished with a sprig of mint and a few extra berries

About


This is delicious and refreshing- with or without the alcohol.
